documents.title: Business Analyst Training
documents.content: The IIBA-endorsed Business Analyst program is 85 hours and is described as 8-9 weeks. It includes 8 real-time projects in Healthcare and Banking. The program is instructor-led live training, classroom and/or online. The page lists interview, resume, and marketing assistance.

documents.title: AI Driven Data Analytics
documents.content: The AI Driven Data Analytics course is 8 to 10 weeks. The curriculum includes Python, NumPy, pandas, Matplotlib, SQL, NoSQL, Excel, and Power BI. It includes hands-on projects and instructor-led live training, classroom and/or online.

documents.title: Quality Assurance Training
documents.content: The Quality Assurance Training course is 100+ hours and approximately 9 weeks. Its curriculum includes manual testing, Selenium WebDriver, API testing with Postman and REST Assured, Git and GitHub, and SQL. The page mentions placement assistance; it does not publish a numerical job-placement rate or guarantee a job.

documents.title: Course Catalog
documents.content: The course catalog lists Business Analyst Training, AI Driven Data Analytics, Quality Assurance Training, Advanced Java Training, QA + BA Integrated Course, and Selenium Training. The site advertises free live demos for several programs.
